statement: Make Group wraps a selection in a group with its own context, name and edit state, isolating geometry from the rest of the model.
superiority: Groups are lightweight components with optional definition sharing.

statement: Double-click enters a group, Esc or outside-click exits; nested groups form a hierarchy with a dimmed outside.

superiority: Isolated editing mode with breadcrumb.

acceptance.sketch: Enter three levels deep and exit; active path matches and outside is dimmed.

statement: Make Component creates a definition with name, description, axes (insertion point), gluing, cut-opening and always face camera options.
superiority: Components can inherit from parent definitions (variants).

acceptance.sketch: Make component from selection; definition and one instance exist; settings stored in the definition.

statement: Edits made inside any instance modify all instances; instances keep their own transform, scale and material overrides.
superiority: Variants per instance without making it unique.

acceptance.sketch: Edit one of 100 instances; all 100 update; material override on one persists.

statement: Make Unique copies a definition so one instance can be edited independently.
superiority: Make unique with automatic naming and link to parent.

acceptance.sketch: Make unique on one of three; the other two are unchanged after the edit.

statement: Component axes set the insertion point and orientation when placed; Set Component Axes edits them.
superiority: Multiple named insertion points.

acceptance.sketch: Change axes; instances' world geometry unchanged and new placements use new origin.

statement: Components can glue to faces (any, horizontal, vertical, sloped), cut openings in faces, and always face the camera.
superiority: Cut openings are non-destructive boolean relations.

acceptance.sketch: Place a window component on a wall; opening cut in the wall and removed on delete.
